title: Incentivizing Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning for Post-Arrival Emergency Care Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.21449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over both structured measurements and free-text records, which makes them attractive for emergency department (ED) prediction. However, most existing LLMs still fall short of conventional ML methods like trees on EHR-based prediction tasks. Our controlled analysis traces this gap to two weaknesses: LLMs do not select informative features, and they misjudge what numerical values imply for risk even when given the right features. We propose TIR-EC, a tool-integrated reinforcement learning framework that addresses both. TIR-EC exposes EHR feature groups as tools the LLM can call. It trains the LLM with rewards from a gradient-boosted tree teacher, which provides a reference set of informative tools and a graded risk target. TIR-EC also distills task-specific clinical skills into the model weights through a reverse curriculum that gradually removes the skills from the prompt during RL process. Evaluati

translated_title: 激励工具使用强化学习用于到院后急诊护理预测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够同时对结构化测量数据和自由文本记录进行推理，这使其在急诊科（ED）预测任务中颇具吸引力。然而，在基于电子健康记录（EHR）的预测任务上，大多数现有LLM仍然不如树模型等传统机器学习方法。我们通过受控分析将这一差距归结为两个弱点：LLM无法选择信息丰富的特征，并且即使获得了正确的特征，也会误判数值对风险的含义。我们提出了TIR-EC，一个能同时解决这两个问题的工具集成强化学习框架。TIR-EC将EHR特征组封装为LLM可调用的工具，并利用梯度提升树教师模型提供的奖励来训练LLM，该教师模型既提供了信息丰富的工具参考集，也提供了分级风险目标。此外，TIR-EC还通过一种反向课程机制，在强化学习过程中逐步从提示中移除这些技能，从而将任务特定的临床技能蒸馏到模型权重中。评估……
tldr: 提出TIR-EC框架，通过工具集成强化学习结合梯度提升树教师奖励与反向课程蒸馏，解决LLM在急诊科到院后护理预测中特征选择不当和数值风险误判的两大弱点。
en_tdlr: TIR-EC is a tool-integrated reinforcement learning framework that leverages gradient-boosted tree teacher rewards and reverse curriculum distillation to address LLMs' weaknesses in feature selection and numerical risk assessment for post-arrival emergency care prediction.
